Large Language Model Systems Toolkit (llms.txt)
===

This project: Gemini Free-Tier Router v0.2
An OpenAI-compatible proxy that runs on one Gemini API key and squeezes ~100% of the free tier out of it via per-model RPM/RPD/TPM scheduling, 429 forensics with self-learning, and quota-aware fallbacks.

Features (v0.2):
- OpenAI-compatible proxy (non-streaming + SSE streaming)
- Quota ledger: RPM (60s sliding window), RPD (PT midnight Pacific reset), TPM (input tokens)
- 429 forensics: classifies daily/minute/token-minute from quotaMetric (wins over quotaId) + RetryInfo + `limit:` text; self-learning `limit: N`; unclassifiable payloads get a capped, jittered 1s-60s backoff
- Fallback engine: re-ranked by remaining daily budget × rolling quality (EMA of success rate + latency)
- Jittered router-owned timers (queue polls, ledger flush, backoff); Google's retryDelay is honored exactly
- Structured JSON logs on stderr (`GFR_LOG=debug|info|warn|error|off`) with a `quota_signal` event per parsed 429
- Keep-alive connection pool toward Google (undici Agent; `GFR_POOL_CONNECTIONS` / `GFR_POOL_KEEPALIVE_MS`)
- Golden 429 fixture corpus (`test/fixtures/429-corpus.json`) as the forensics regression net
- 9-model free-tier fleet + 2 embedding models
- `/v1/models`, `/v1/chat/completions`, `/healthz`, `/admin`, `/metrics`, `/admin/simulate`, `/v1/embeddings` endpoints
- `x-gfr-tier: bulk|standard|scarce` QoS header
- `GFR_DRY_RUN=1` flag for synthetic responses (no upstream call, no quota spent; response carries `x-gfr-dry-run: 1`)
- Client-disconnect upstream abort (saves wasted TPM)
- Burn-rate curve: `even` (allows `max(1, ceil(elapsed/24h A- rpd))` so far) / `front-loaded` (no pacing)
- TypeScript + Hono on Node 22 with node:sqlite WAL ledger

Spec: SPEC.md
